verdict.rationale: Storage pricing is a fair question for a cloud document and collaboration platform like SharePoint, so the axis applies. However, the evidence pack contains no public pricing page, per-plan storage quotas, per-user prices, or description of what happens when storage hits the cap. The cited docs cover only developer APIs and webhooks, and the one community licensing-cost anecdote is a private quote, not published storage pricing.

support.subject: As a founder, storage pricing is published — per-plan storage quotas and per-user prices on a public page, including what happens at the cap
